title: The middle factor of a composite is of finite presentation when the composite is and the second factor is of finite type
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in a composite of morphisms of algebraic stacks the first factor is locally of finite presentation as soon as the composite is locally of finite presentation and the second factor is locally of finite type (author lemma at source lines 5682-5688, label lemma-finite-presentation-permanence). The proof (source lines 5690-5701) chooses three compatible smooth covers and reduces the assertion to the corresponding permanence statement for algebraic spaces (proof lines 5691-5700). The reduction through the covers is the content. H2.
